localFacts.fact: CBS: men aged 20 or older in the Netherlands were on average 1,81 m tall in 2018, women 1,67 m. Replaces the CDC US average for the eye-level check.

Commissariaat voor de Media: the Mediawet rules for video-uploaders (e.g. recognisable advertising) apply regardless of follower count; uploaders under active supervision only have to register with the Commissariaat once they have 100.000 or more followers. Supervision covers Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. General information, not legal advice.
KLM allows one cabin bag of max. 55 x 35 x 25 cm including handles and wheels; the Befree Advanced folds to 40 cm.
Vanguard (vanguardworld.nl / .de) sells the EU ALTA PRO 263AB G2: 171 cm max, 69,5 cm folded, 2,29 kg, 10 kg load.
Local terms: statiefkop, balhoofd, fluid head/videokop, middenkolom, snelkoppelplaat; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.
